authorityOrder: user explicit instruction in current task
page manifest and page polish manifest page-specific visual/production constraints
docs/rurubu-v30/FIGMA-EXECUTION-ACCEPTANCE.md post-build visual acceptance and feedback process
older V20/history only as non-authoritative reference

beforeAnyV30PageWrite: page README.md when production has already started
requiredReadSet.rule: Manifest files are necessary but not sufficient. A production agent must also read the actual Visual Master and the pre-build/post-build audit documents. Newer visual-polish/page-polish overrides must be read before relying on older generic rules.

workflowOwnership.hardRule: Do not jump into direct Figma modification or production ImageGen while manifest/feedback debt is open. ChatGPT does not perform those production writes unless the user explicitly reassigns them in a later instruction.
workflowOwnership.handoffGate: Before Codex implementation, relevant systemic feedback and page-specific feedback must be represented in authority, contradictory older behavior must be explicitly replaced, and required visual review gates must be satisfied.

coupleNames.rule: Across P01-P08, never invent, misspell, swap, translate, abbreviate, or OCR-correct Shogo/Shiori without explicit user instruction.

weddingDate.rule: Across P01-P08, 2026.10.24 is authoritative. Never infer another date from generated imagery, examples, OCR, old versions, or placeholders.

figmaCoordinateSystem.basis: A5 trim at 96 dpi-equivalent Figma logical pixels
figmaCoordinateSystem.rule: All page-specific geometry should include normalized ratios plus Figma trim-pixel approximations. Normalized geometry is authoritative when source image dimensions differ.

printRasterTarget.rule: Any full-page raster intended for final print must provide sufficient effective resolution at placed size; reference images may be lower because they are visual masters, not print masters.

levels.LOCKED: Must not change without explicit user instruction. Use for facts, page role, hard rejects, critical hierarchy and safety/print constraints.
levels.TARGET: Aim to match the visual master closely, but allow controlled movement when direct visual comparison improves fidelity.
levels.FLEXIBLE: May vary to solve local composition, photo crop or production constraints, while preserving page role and hierarchy.

defaultTolerance.note: These are first-pass tolerances, not a license to drift. Tighten after direct overlay/reference comparison.

constraintModel.rule: Exact pixel coordinates are guides, not the highest authority. If a small geometric deviation produces a closer visual match to the page visual master while preserving LOCKED constraints, prefer the visual match.
constraintModel.antiOverconstraint: Do not mechanically satisfy coordinates at the expense of editorial rhythm, human irregularity, hierarchy, or visual fidelity.

order: visual master first impression and three-second hierarchy
constraintConflictResolution.rule: When two constraints conflict, resolve toward the higher item and record the deviation reason instead of silently forcing all constraints.

visualAuthorityPolicy.principle: Page visual-master images outrank prose-only design interpretation for visual execution, but the Visual Master itself must not be reused as contaminated photo-slot content.
workflow: review the page visual master
extract page-specific visual grammar
complete PASS A and PASS B visual-master lock audit
classify fixed bundled display modules vs native/variable copy
classify every real-photo slot and clean standalone proxy role
lock hierarchy, background, frame, relationship and constraint behavior in the page manifest/page polish manifest
close systemic/page feedback debt that affects the next implementation
create or confirm a full-page art-direction proof
only then decompose the proven page into independently positionable editorial objects or bundled modules
handoff production ImageGen/Figma execution to Codex
reconstruct in layered Figma with replaceable photography and controlled factual source metadata
install clean representative visual proxies if final photos are absent
capture the current Figma screenshot
pass clean-proxy gate
pass fixed-display-module gate
pass identity-anchor gate
pass visual carry-over/coherence gate when inherited assets exist
pass direct Reference Delta against the Visual Master
perform photo-swap/A5/print QA
review owner feedback and write systemic lessons back to authority before repeating the method on another page
visualAuthorityPolicy.figmaPolicy: Figma is the layered compositor, not the source of magazine personality. Fixed short display modules may be placed as complete prepared assets rather than rebuilt from generic primitives.
visualAuthorityPolicy.wholePagePolicy: Whole-page reference images are art-direction masters; final production remains layered at editorial-object/module level with independently replaceable real photos.
visualAuthorityPolicy.gate0: At a 3-second glance, the intended editorial identity and page role must read correctly before technical QA can pass.
visualAuthorityPolicy.antiFalseComplete: A technically clean Figma file is not complete if a high-saliency identity anchor, contaminated proxy, stale inherited module, or first-impression relationship materially diverges from the Visual Master.

identityAnchorPolicy.definition: A high-saliency element whose silhouette/lettering/treatment materially defines the page identity, such as a masthead, main title, names lockup or signature badge.
identityAnchorPolicy.editabilityRule: Use native editable text/vector only when it preserves the Visual Master. Never accept a visibly generic substitute merely because it is easier to edit.
identityAnchorPolicy.sourceOfTruthRule: For fixed short FACT display art, the exact approved value must live in canonical/page manifest or asset metadata. A duplicate hidden native Figma layer is optional, not mandatory.
hardRejects: generic font substitution for a signature masthead
generic bold sans substitution for expressive script/hand-lettered identity text
simplifying an identity badge into a generic oval/circle when its silhouette is distinctive
passing an identity anchor because the words are spelled correctly while its visual character is wrong

bundledDisplayModulePolicy.principle: If short fixed text, numbers, background/vessel, icons and local accents visually behave as one authored object, they may and often should be generated/prepared as one complete display asset.
mustRemainSeparate: decorations the Visual Master clearly positions/moves independently
bundledDisplayModulePolicy.sourceOfTruth: Exact approved fixed strings/numbers are stored in manifest or asset metadata and QA-checked against generated visible output; hidden duplicate Figma text is optional.
bundledDisplayModulePolicy.partGenerationRule: Every page must explicitly classify bundledDisplayModules and nativeOrVariableCopy before part generation. Pages still awaiting Visual Master review must not invent this classification from prose alone.
hardRejects: generic ellipse + generic font reconstruction of an authored badge solely for editability
splitting a fixed module into many primitives when that makes it UI-like
bundling replaceable photography into the fixed module
baking long/TBD/personal copy into generated display art
bundling unrelated decorations only to reduce layer count

relationalConstraintPolicy.rule: Record important visual relationships between objects. Relationship constraints outrank exact x/y when preserving the visual master.
relationalConstraintPolicy.example: A hero title may be TARGET-positioned but LOCKED to remain visually dominant over teaser modules.

quietZonePolicy.purpose: Prevent AI/Codex from filling every available gap and destroying editorial breathing room or face safety.
quietZonePolicy.rule: Do not add stickers, copy, badges or decorative objects inside a declared quiet zone unless the page visual master explicitly does so.

saliencyPolicy.rule: Every major object should receive a visual saliency weight after review. Higher-weight objects must remain perceptually stronger than lower-weight objects.
saliencyPolicy.antiFailure: Never improve a low-saliency decoration by weakening a higher-saliency title, hero image, canonical fact or primary page promise.

rules.generated-art: Expressive display art, irregular editorial vessels, frames, stamps, tickets, paper objects, borders and decorative systems may be generated/prepared art.
rules.bundled-display-module: A fixed authored module may combine short visible text/numbers with its vessel/icons/accents into one asset; visible text need not be editable.
rules.native-text: Long, variable, TBD or precision factual/editorial copy remains native when correctness/editability matters.
rules.replaceable-photo: Real-photo slots are independent from their frame/backing and remain non-destructively replaceable.
rules.figma-shape-ok: Simple utility geometry may use Figma primitives only when doing so does not weaken the visual master.
rules.display-art-with-source-metadata: For short fixed FACT display art, preserve exact source value in canonical/page manifest or asset metadata and QA visible spelling/numbering. A hidden duplicate Figma text layer is optional.

renderModePolicy.fidelityPriority: Editability is a production requirement only where future editing is genuinely needed; it is not permission to replace expressive fixed art with generic native styling.

rules: FACT must come from canonical/user-approved data only.
Generated text is never authoritative FACT by itself.
EDITORIAL_COPY may be rewritten only within the approved page role.
DECORATIVE_FICTION may be stylized but must not impersonate a real fact.
TBD must remain clearly unresolved and must not be silently invented.
Visible display rendering and source-of-truth are separate concerns: exact FACT value remains controlled in manifest/metadata even when the visible fixed module is raster/vector display art.

faceSafePolicy.preferredFocus: faces first, then essential hands/props when editorially important
faceSafePolicy.rule: Do not let decorative overlays or frame fronts cross eyes/faces unless the visual master intentionally does so. If a real source photo requires a different crop, adjust within TARGET geometry before violating face safety.

preferredSourceOrder: approved clean standalone semantically matching photo
clean generated standalone photo proxy without page-layout decoration
hardRejects: crop from P01.png/P02.png/etc used as photo fill
page screenshot used as photo fill
proxy containing page title/border/badge/flower sticker/route/ticket/frame/story vessel or other layout decoration
object/place proxy validating a people-dominant hero
single-person proxy validating a two-person hero when face mass matters
generic landscape validating a group-memory slot
claiming Reference Delta pass from a structural or contaminated proxy

dummyPhotoPolicy.rule: Dummy imagery may prove structure, but it must be a clean standalone photo with no page-layout decoration. A high-saliency slot requires a semantically representative clean VISUAL_PROXY before visual completion can be claimed. Dummy imagery is never autobiographical fact and remains replaceable without rebuilding the frame.

replacementQa: inspect proxy in isolation and confirm it reads as photo content only
verify no page typography/border/sticker/frame/background decoration is baked into proxy
swap portrait source into each applicable slot
swap landscape source into each applicable slot
test high-subject and low-subject focal positions
test left/right focal positions where relevant
verify no gap caused by crop mode
verify frame/backing does not need rebuilding
verify important faces/subjects are not covered by must-not-cover elements
verify replacing proxy does not remove any intended page decoration

layerSystem.rule: zIndex is a reconstruction aid. Preserve front/back relationships first; exact numeric values may change if the relationship remains correct.

requiredPerPage: quiet zones created by the background
backgroundSystem.rule: A weak generic gradient or empty field must not replace page-specific background art when the visual master depends on it.

frameSystem.rule: Frames are editorial objects, not a single repeated rounded-card component. Each page may use unequal frame families.

componentizationPolicy.principle: Reuse only when semantic purpose is shared and variation is predictable. Visual similarity alone is not enough.
hardRejects: equalizing modules merely to reuse a component
identical padding/radius/icon placement across modules that differ in the Visual Master
treating editorial freeform clusters as UI cards
componentizationPolicy.rule: Prefer page-specific variants or separate assemblies when reuse would normalize authored irregularity.

assetProductionPolicy.onePartDefinition: One independently movable editorial object = one production image. A bundled fixed display module counts as one editorial object even if it contains internal text, numbers, background, icons and local accents. Replaceable real photos never count as part of that bundled module.

requiredBeforeGeneratingParts: feedback debt affecting implementation written back
full-page visual proof accepted or existing visual master confirmed
blockedIf: page still reads as generic wedding/travel collage
fixed display modules are not classified
proxy plan relies on Visual Master crops/page screenshots
systemic feedback debt is not yet represented in authority
partGenerationGate.rule: Do not start production ImageGen/Figma merely because geometry is known. Manifest/review classification must be complete first.

assetProductionPolicy.targetedRevisionRule: When one isolated asset/module is weak, revise/regenerate that asset first and explicitly state what must change and what must remain unchanged. Do not regenerate the whole page merely to fix one identity anchor/module.
assetProductionPolicy.floatingAssetFormat: PNG/RGBA with true transparency unless opacity is intentional
assetProductionPolicy.fullPageBackgroundFormat: opaque PNG/JPG or prepared raster as appropriate

assetPaddingContract.rule: Transparent padding must not silently change perceived size or placement. Crop/trim or account for it explicitly before Figma placement.

assetProductionPolicy.alphaVerificationRule: A checkerboard-looking generator preview is not proof of transparency. Inspect the actual alpha channel and reject baked checkerboard pixels before a floating asset is adopted.
assetMetadataRequired: exact fixed text/numbers when baked into display art

placementPolicy.rule: Do not rely on prose such as 'near the top'. Record measurable placement after visual review, but treat exact pixels as lower authority than the visual master and relational constraints.

requiresReasonWhen: visual proxy semantics differ from master
deviationPolicy.forbiddenReason: convenience, editability alone, generic template normalization, or preserving sunk work

humanFeedbackPolicy.rule: When user/owner feedback reveals a repeatable failure mode, do not fix only the current Figma page. Record the lesson in authority before the same production method is applied to another page.

completionTerminology.FIGMA_STRUCTURE_READY: Layering, masks, source control and replaceability are ready; no visual-fidelity claim.
completionTerminology.CLEAN_PROXY_PASS: All active proxy photos are clean standalone photo content without Visual-Master/page decoration baked in.
completionTerminology.BUNDLED_DISPLAY_MODULE_PASS: All fixed authored display modules are correctly bundled/separated according to page manifest and do not regress into generic editable UI.
completionTerminology.REPRESENTATIVE_VISUAL_PROXY_READY: High-saliency slots use semantically representative clean visual proxies when final photos are absent.
completionTerminology.IDENTITY_ANCHOR_PASS: Signature visual anchors preserve the Visual Master's character.
completionTerminology.VISUAL_CARRYOVER_PASS: Every material inherited visible asset has been requalified/reworked/replaced/superseded in the current design language.
completionTerminology.REFERENCE_DELTA_PASS: Current screenshot passes direct visual comparison against the Visual Master after clean-proxy/module/carry-over checks.
completionTerminology.HUMAN_FEEDBACK_REVIEWED: Owner feedback has been reviewed and systemic lessons written back.
completionTerminology.FIGMA_DESIGN_COMPLETE: All applicable visual, structural and QA gates pass.
completionTerminology.FINAL_PHOTO_QA_PENDING: Final real sources are not installed/rechecked yet.
completionTerminology.rule: Never use FIGMA_COMPLETE as shorthand for structure-only completion.

productionStateMachine.rule: Advance only when the prior applicable state's required evidence exists. Technical completion cannot skip clean-proxy, bundled-display-module, identity-anchor, carry-over, Reference Delta or feedback stages.

referenceDeltaPolicy.method: overlay/side-by-side against the page visual master at matching aspect ratio using the current Figma screenshot; proxy photos themselves must be clean and may not contain cropped page decoration.
referenceDeltaPolicy.blockingRule: Any material failure in clean-proxy integrity, fixed display-module fidelity, carry-over coherence, first impression, identity anchor, high-saliency photo semantics, title/photo scale or major occupied-vs-calm areas blocks Reference Delta pass.
referenceDeltaPolicy.rule: Do not accept a technically correct rebuild that fails the first-impression, module, proxy or coherence comparison.

printChecks: critical factual text remains safe/readable including baked fixed display text
effective raster resolution at placed size
sRGB review export before CMYK conversion workflow

pairs.rule: coherent profile/story family without cloning the same card/grid system
travel-to-friends transition; maintain energy while differentiating photo rhythm
lively real-life page followed by a calmer closing page

pages.role: REAL LIFE / FAVORITES / BEST SHOTS + Q5/Q6
